summary: Re-review of Phase 4 range 57baaaa..edee50b (HEAD verified) with focus on the remediation range 3581902..edee50b (8 commits: ruling 154eb7d, Red c5ea02c/aec19a2/dd57da7/07418d2, Green 75f7419/1a2817d/edee50b). F1 is resolved: spec D10 now rules the message line into <private>/sets/<set_id>/messages/<diff_id>.txt, review-run.sh prepends it between review-prompt.md and the seeded diff for the pass and the probe, refuses a missing or empty file before the lock and any call, and the private sets hold 14 and 6 non-empty one-line message files. I reproduced every gate claim exactly: review-run 43 pass 0 fail 329 expect() calls, seed-messages 9 pass 0 fail 41 expect() calls (both under bun), judge-run 22 passed and adversarial-p4-runner 14 passed (both under the recorded vitest line), with no orphan fake-opencode or quota-server process after each run. N1 (strategy closeout item 6) is fixed, N2 (D18 second source) is recorded in the plan at 4.13/4.14, N4 (probe retry) is fixed by the D14 reword, and N5 (bun timeout) is fixed by the recorded vitest gate. N3 stays open (neither fixed nor recorded). Three new nonblocking findings on the ruling commit: the D10 text names pick-diffs.ts as the message writer though no tool writes messages for a new or reseeded set, the D10 text says the runner never reads keys/ while the probe reads a key to find the control diff, and the PM 2026-11-18 'gate net above 0' ruling changed the spec and the strategy text but left real-work.ts, guide.ts, and preview-gate.test.ts on the old '>= 20' rule with no task assigned. The four contract-violation arrays are empty: the audited remediation work is correct, tested failing-first, and in scope.
nonblocking_findings: N3 carried (major, unchanged from review-a-3581902, harness/model-guide/real-work.ts:677-684 vs test-strategy.md:1944 Q-S5): The footer row count counts only outcomes rows with a string route, a kind of producer or gate, and a string role, and silently skips the rest, while Q-S5 says the row count is the length of the outcomes array. On the real file the two agree (217 rows, verified with node at the previous review), so no live number is wrong today; a malformed row in a later weekly export would undercount without a refusal line. The remediation range neither fixes nor records this. Fix or record it before the first weekly update (task 5.4).

N6 (major, measure/tracks/model_guide/spec.md:471-472): The D10 ruling says 'The seeder `pick-diffs.ts` writes it from the source commit', but pick-diffs.ts writes only the candidates file and never touches sets/ (its own test header, seed-messages.test.ts:11-12, and the pick-diffs note in measure/runs/model_guide/red-4.13c.txt record this). No tool or runbook step at HEAD writes message files for a new or reseeded set: the pilot seeding and reseed runbook (plan.md:1016, task 3.16, reused by 4.11 for mg-2026-11p2/p3) names no message step. A reseed or a new quarter set would produce a set whose every pass and probe refuses with 'the message file of <diff_id> is missing'. Fix: reword spec D10 to name the actual writer (the backfill tool or the fixture-author runbook), and add the message-seeding step to the reseed runbook of task 3.16/4.11 before the first reseed.

N7 (minor, measure/tracks/model_guide/spec.md:473-474 vs harness/model-guide/review-run.sh:603): The D10 ruling says 'The runner reads `diffs/` and `messages/` only. It never reads `keys/`', but run_probe reads `keys/<diff_id>.json` to find the control diff (the diff whose key holds no plant). The intended claim, that the call input holds no key data, is honored and pinned by M1/M2 (the stdin holds only the prompt, the message line, and the seeded diff). A closeout checker that reads D10 literally fails the correct file, the same pattern as the old N1. Fix: reword the sentence to 'The call input reads `diffs/` and `messages/` only; it holds no key data and no `src/` data.'

N8 (major, measure/tracks/model_guide/spec.md:959, 977, 1097, 1212 and test-strategy.md:1638, 1694 vs harness/model-guide/real-work.ts:42 and harness/model-guide-tests/preview-gate.test.ts:1945-1966): The PM 2026-11-18 'gate net above 0' ruling changed the D16/D18 pick rule and the 'not for verdicts' mark in the spec and in the DS12/DS13 strategy rows (DS13 now says 'Review B picks gate-one (60 %, 5 runs, net 18.5)'), but real-work.ts still holds NET_SCORE_GATE = 20 (the mark at :498/:523 and the gate pick at :609), guide.ts is unchanged, and preview-gate.test.ts G6 still pins 'Review B: no pick yet' with the comment 'a below-minimum net score stops Review B'. No open task (4.10-4.14 or Phase 5) assigns the change, so the strategy text and the pinned test now contradict each other. Fix before task 4.14 regenerates the page: assign a Red/Green task for the new rule, or mark the ruling with its effective phase and revert the DS12/DS13 text until then.

N9 (nit, measure/tracks/model_guide/plan.md:1817): Task 4.10 says 'The probe of 2026-11-19 runs before 4.9f', but 4.9f is complete ([x], Green 75f7419, 2026-11-18), so the probe cannot run before it. The sentence likely means before night 1 (task 4.12). Fix the wording in the open row.
